list_knowledge_bases.name: list_knowledge_bases
list_knowledge_bases.description: List the knowledge bases this endpoint can access, with their id, name, description and which retrieval modes (semantic, keyword, wiki) each supports. Call this first to learn what is in scope; other tools accept either the id or the exact name.

search_knowledge.name: search_knowledge
search_knowledge.description: Search the knowledge bases in scope and return the most relevant passages with their document ids and titles. mode hybrid (default) combines semantic and keyword retrieval; semantic ranks by meaning; keyword matches exact terms, identifiers, codes or names.

knowledge_base_ids.description: Optional knowledge base ids or names to restrict the search; defaults to every knowledge base in scope

limit.description: Maximum passages to return, default 10, max 30

query.description: A natural-language question, topic, or the exact terms to match

wiki_index.name: wiki_index
wiki_index.description: Browse the table of contents of one knowledge base's wiki: the intro plus pages grouped by type (summary, entity, concept, ...).

knowledge_base_id.description: Knowledge base id or exact name

limit.description: Maximum entries per page type, default 50, max 200

wiki_read_page.name: wiki_read_page
wiki_read_page.description: Read one wiki page by slug, including its content and outgoing links.

knowledge_base_id.description: Knowledge base id or name, required only when the same slug exists in several wikis

slug.description: Page slug from wiki_search or wiki_index, e.g. concept/rag

grep_chunks.name: grep_chunks
grep_chunks.description: Case-insensitive regular-expression search over the text chunks of the knowledge bases in scope. Best for exact terms, identifiers, error codes or product names that semantic search may miss. Candidates come from the keyword index (the semantic index for bases without one) using the literal terms in the pattern, and every returned chunk matches the pattern.

knowledge_base_ids.description: Optional knowledge base ids or names to restrict the search

limit.description: Maximum passages to return, default 10, max 30

query.description: Regular expression (POSIX, case-insensitive) to match against chunk text; text that is not a valid regular expression is matched literally

wiki_search.name: wiki_search
wiki_search.description: Search the generated wiki pages of the knowledge bases in scope by title, alias and content. Returns page slugs that wiki_read_page accepts. Only knowledge bases with a wiki are searched.

knowledge_base_ids.description: Optional knowledge base ids or names to restrict the search

limit.description: Maximum pages to return, default 10, max 50

query.description: Search terms or a regular expression (case-insensitive POSIX); text that is not a valid regular expression is matched literally

regex.description: false forces a literal match; true requires a valid regular expression; omit for the default behaviour

upload_document.name: upload_document
upload_document.description: Upload complete file bytes as canonical base64, never a local path or URL. Supports scanned PDF, DOCX, XLSX, TXT and Markdown up to 8 MiB. Reuse idempotency_key for retries. Discover a writable KB first; exact names are accepted.

get_document_processing_status.name: get_document_processing_status
get_document_processing_status.description: Read processing status for a document created by this Key; permission is checked again. No document content or storage paths are returned.

add_document.name: add_document
add_document.description: Create Markdown/text knowledge with a required idempotency key. Processing is asynchronous. Reuse the key only for the identical request. URLs and local file paths are unsupported.

read_document.name: read_document
read_document.description: Read a document's metadata and its text chunks in order. Page through long documents with offset and limit, or pass query to return only the chunks containing a phrase (with one chunk of context on each side).

knowledge_id.description: Document id from search results or list_documents

limit.description: Number of chunks to return, default 20, max 100

offset.description: Chunk offset to start from, default 0

query.description: Optional case-insensitive phrase to find inside the document

list_documents.name: list_documents
list_documents.description: List the documents inside one knowledge base with pagination and an optional title keyword filter. Returns document ids that read_document accepts.

keyword.description: Optional substring to filter document titles

knowledge_base_id.description: Knowledge base id or exact name

list_writable_knowledge_bases.name: list_writable_knowledge_bases
list_writable_knowledge_bases.description: List current knowledge bases where this Key's owner may add content. Rechecked on every write.

wiki_index.name: wiki_index
wiki_index.description: Read a verified Wiki directory without creating an index page. Results are bounded; truncation and unavailable provenance are explicit.

knowledge_base_id.description: Knowledge base id or exact name

limit.description: Maximum entries per page type, default 50, max 200

offset.description: Optional result offset (0..1000); large scopes may be explicitly truncated.

wiki_read_page.name: wiki_read_page
wiki_read_page.description: Read one wiki page by slug, including its content and outgoing links.

knowledge_base_id.description: Knowledge base id or name, required only when the same slug exists in several wikis

offset.description: Optional result offset (0..1000); large scopes may be explicitly truncated.

slug.description: Page slug from wiki_search or wiki_index, e.g. concept/rag

wiki_search.name: wiki_search
wiki_search.description: Search verified published Wiki pages across the current personal knowledge scope using bounded literal text. Unknown or revoked sources are omitted with a partial warning.

knowledge_base_ids.description: Optional exact authorized KB IDs; omit to search all personal wikis.

limit.description: Maximum pages to return, default 10, max 50

offset.description: Optional result offset (0..1000); large scopes may be explicitly truncated.

query.description: Search terms or a regular expression (case-insensitive POSIX); text that is not a valid regular expression is matched literally

regex.description: false forces a literal match; true requires a valid regular expression; omit for the default behaviour
